doc_title_en: Notification of Revision to FY12/26 2Q (Interim) and Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Year-End Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
doc_title_jp: 2026年12月期 第２四半期(中間期)及び通期連結業績予想並びに 期末配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 通期業績予想の上方修正に伴い、配当性向30%以上の基本方針に基づき期末配当を増配

summary_en: FY12/26 year-end dividend raised from ¥51 to ¥93 per share (+42 yen, +83%). Full-year dividend guidance increased to ¥144/share. Payout ratio floor 30%+ maintained. Upward revision of H1 and full-year earnings drove increase.
summary_jp: FY12/26期末配当51円から93円に引き上げ（+42円、+83%）。通期配当予想144円/株に上方修正。配当性向30%以上を維持。上期・通期業績上方修正が増配根拠。
tag_en: Dividend Hike - FY12/26 Year-End: ¥51 → ¥93/share (+83%) - FY12/26 Total: ¥144/share - Payout ratio 30%+
